name: Risk Assessment
definition: Inquiries about the risk levels associated with specific locations or activities in relation to COVID-19.

name: Treatment Information
definition: Requests for information regarding treatments or medications related to COVID-19.

name: Travel Safety
definition: Questions about the safety of traveling during the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: Pet Safety
definition: Inquiries regarding the safety of pets in relation to COVID-19.

name: Donation Requests
definition: Requests for information on how to donate money or resources to support COVID-19 relief efforts.

name: Current Statistics
definition: Requests for the latest statistics and updates on COVID-19 cases, recoveries, and deaths.

name: Preventive Measures
definition: Inquiries about ways to stay safe and prevent the spread of COVID-19.

name: Public Health Guidelines
definition: Questions about guidelines or recommendations from health authorities regarding COVID-19.

name: Economic Impact
definition: Inquiries about the economic effects of COVID-19 and related crises.

name: Vaccine Information
definition: Questions regarding the availability and efficacy of vaccines for COVID-19.

name: Myths and Misinformation
definition: Inquiries aimed at clarifying myths or misinformation surrounding COVID-19.

name: Community Updates
definition: Requests for updates specific to local areas regarding COVID-19.

name: Essential Worker Guidance
definition: Information and recommendations for essential workers on how to protect themselves and others while performing their duties.

name: Travel Restrictions
definition: Information regarding travel bans, restrictions, and advisories related to COVID-19.

name: Animal Safety
definition: Concerns and information regarding the impact of COVID-19 on pets and other animals.

name: Symptom Inquiry
definition: Questions related to the symptoms of COVID-19 and their implications.
